## Computing the Riemann Hypothesis: Thorin Measures, Pólya Densities and Hitting Times

- [Computing the Riemann Hypothesis: Thorin Measures, Pólya Densities and Hitting Times](https://vsokolov.org/books/computing_rh/index.html.md): by Nicholas G. Polson and Vadim Sokolov (2026). Computes the Thorin measure whose positivity is equivalent to the Riemann Hypothesis, from Pólya's integral for Xi in certified ball arithmetic, and proves that finite positivity tests on the heat trace cannot decide it; with hitting times, the reciprocal zeta function and Lee Yang theory.
- [Results by chapter](https://vsokolov.org/books/computing_rh/results.html.md): 250 results with their statements, status and numbers
- [Catalog of results](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/VadimSokolov/computing_rh/main/RESULTS.md): 250 results with their statements, status and printed numbers
- [The book as a PDF](https://github.com/VadimSokolov/computing_rh/releases/download/v1.0.0/computing_rh.pdf): 742 pages, CC BY 4.0
- [Source on GitHub](https://github.com/VadimSokolov/computing_rh/tree/v1.0.0): the LaTeX source, code and bibliography
